code_examples.section: ltm rule command TCP enhanced loss recovery
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

TCP::enhanced_loss_recovery
       Toggles enhanced loss recovery.

SYNOPSIS
       TCP::enhanced_loss_recovery BOOL_VALUE

DESCRIPTION
       Enables or disables enhanced loss recovery which recovers from random packet loss more effectively.

       Syntax

       TCP::enhanced_loss_recovery 

RETURN VALUE
       None.

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT.

EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {
	    TCP::enhanced_loss_recovery enable
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-13.0.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
